title: agrostis nigricans
intro: Agrostis nigricans, commonly known as Black Bent-grass or Black Bent, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis nigricans include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Agrostis nigricans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
